title: BSEE dated workover plan sequence teaching subset
labelDefinition: EST_OPERATION_DAYS, submitted estimated/planned duration in days; no actual completion outcome.
selection: Rows with parsed submitted/planned-start dates and positive EST_OPERATION_DAYS. Collapse API+planned-start groups to earliest submission; select whole wells with at least six groups, sorted by group count descending/API ascending, up to300 rows. No label-value balancing.
chronology: Sort by SUB_STAT_DATE then API and SN_APM. Prior-history eligibility uses strictly earlier submittedAt within the same well. First two records per well are warmup. Global 60/20/20 chronological partitions; partition cut times are selected by record dates, never target values. Walk-forward validation/test may use earlier revealed labels as history without fitting new weights.
boundary: Administrative plans are irregular events. Different planned starts may still be postponements/revisions of one field job. This is not independent completed workover-job history, and plannedStartDate is not a measured start.
textPolicy: Published snapshot uses only normalized operationText, official codes, and source-derived keywords. The local-review sourceDescriptionSnippet field was removed from every record; original local research files remain unchanged.
license: Federal factual data; see https://www.bsee.gov/bsee/privacy-policy . Third-party operator prose retains its own status; deployment should use normalized operationText.

summary.sourceTimezone: Not asserted; retained source wall-clock timestamps without adding a UTC Z.
